notes.title: Bug Fix Update!
notes.content:
Hello, players!

We are pleased to announce that we have fixed the bug that prevented some of you from closing the window at the begin and in the end of the game. Thank you for your patience and feedback! Keep enjoying the game, and we will continue working to make your experience even better.

Best regards,
BanzaiProject Team

notes.title: Lust Epidemic is out – save the kingdom from the plague! 😷
notes.content:
The wait is over! Step into the shoes of an ordinary guy who started by trying to help his sister and now is saving the world! 

This world is gripped by a mysterious lust disease, and it’s up to you to save the kingdom. Mysterious forest girl Lynfee will teach you to cure the infected girls in the only way possible - through adult action! 

Explore beautiful 2D art, uncover secrets that everyone hides and battle the plague as you progress on your quest to find patient zero and cure everyone. Save hot girls and learn more about the epidemic. We’re excited for you to dive in! Get ready for hot 18+ scenes, strategic choices, and an immersive story that will keep you hooked from start to finish - grab your free key and play right now!
